text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,800.6, up 1.12% on the day and 2.61% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.8% (1.49% five‑day). Advances (247) almost matched declines (243), giving a breadth score of 69.9 – a “healthy” market breadth. Bank Nifty led the rally, gaining 2.49% (5.9% five‑day) to 64,635.2. The India VIX jumped 7.5% to 17.32, signalling higher volatility, but the overall move was broad‑based across most sectors.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding INR 10,308.42 crore today, extending a 17‑day buying streak, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 4,859.8 crore. In the options market, the Nifty PCR (put‑call ratio) is 1.67, indicating more puts than calls, and the “max pain” level sits at 25,500. The expected trading range is 25,609‑25,992, with a call wall at 26,000 and a put wall at 24,500. Bank Nifty shows a PCR of 1.37, max pain at 62,500 and an expected range of 63,956‑65,313, with resistance near 66,000.

Watch the 25,657 point pivot (S1 25,494, R1 25,958) for Nifty and the 63,972 point pivot for Bank Nifty (S1 63,262, R1 65,344). Key headlines to monitor include global gold rally, US inflation data, and any shift in Brent crude below $90, which could influence risk appetite. Keep an eye on the “call wall” at 26,000 for Nifty – a level that may cap upside if sellers step in.
